reviewRisk.reason: This change retires tests and legacy runtime paths and alters real Worker/D1/browser verification and navigation behavior.

review.reviewer: /root/final_candidate_independent_review (source review at code-identical 4ecc9dd; tracked-document follow-up at 0a5112c3)

criteria.expected: A single root pnpm workspace supports frozen installation and the intended static-export routes.
criteria.actual: Root pnpm install --frozen-lockfile completed for both workspace projects. pnpm build succeeded, includes /scanner, and omits /prototype.

criteria.expected: The canonical local readiness aggregate and required Programs parity stages pass on a clean candidate.
criteria.actual: pnpm verify exited 0 on this SHA. It passed 659 Worker tests, 1,184 component tests, 427-file governance audit with zero active violations, Worker Contract, 70 Browser, five Home, 21 Responsive, seven Feed, and non-browser precommit stages; shell-responsive passed 92 with one configured skip, shell geometry 35, and role-hierarchy geometry 49.

criteria.expected: Current Storybook documentation and generated index exclude the retired credential-upgrade Story.
criteria.actual: Tracked docs were corrected. After an independent review found the ignored generated index was stale, Storybook was rebuilt; the index check passed with 95 Stories and 36 obligations, and the retired credential-upgrade ID is absent.

criteria.expected: The bounded Drizzle trial is not adopted when its measured maintenance surface does not improve.
criteria.actual: No Drizzle dependency or adapter remains; the published-announcement read uses native D1 SQL, and the plan records the trial's stop result.

criteria.expected: A fresh independent reviewer exercises the current candidate's real Worker/D1/browser boundary and returns an acceptance disposition.
criteria.actual: Independent source review covered the code-identical 4ecc9dd tree and a 0a5112c documentation follow-up, but the reviewer did not run Worker/D1/browser commands. Builder-run local aggregate is green; independent runtime acceptance remains open.

criteria.expected: Remove the three GitHub Actions workflows and the Fast CI required status in one admin-authorized change window.
criteria.actual: The main protection ruleset is active and still requires Fast CI. The connected GitHub identity has WRITE permission only, so the workflows remain until a repository administrator can remove the required check in the same window.

criteria.expected: Confirm the exact Cloudflare Worker, route, D1, and rate-limit identities before changing deployment configuration.
criteria.actual: The connected Cloudflare account returned zero Workers and zero D1 databases; EFCC's target may be under another account or zone. No deployment identity or remote resource was changed.

criteria.expected: Close deferred Auth/revocation/password-login protection, B-003 runtime canary, and comparable agent-context measurement before claiming those outcomes.
criteria.actual: Auth and emergency revocation/password brute-force protection remain deferred pre-production work; the five-minute B-003 canary and four-task before/after agent-context benchmark were not run. No token reduction is claimed.

criteria.expected: Keep owner approval, device review, deployment, and release evidence distinct from local verification.
criteria.actual: No owner sign-off, real-device review, deployment, or release was performed.

limitations: The full local pnpm verify, frozen install, production build, and final Storybook build/index check ran locally; they do not prove a Cloudflare deployment or real-device behavior.
A repository administrator must remove the active Fast CI required check in the same window as workflow deletion; the current GitHub identity lacks admin permission.
The connected Cloudflare account contains no visible EFCC Worker or D1 resources; target identity remains unknown.
The independent source reviewer did not run Worker/D1/browser commands. The final high-risk runtime acceptance is therefore not independently reviewed.

Auth library migration, emergency session revocation, password-login brute-force protection, B-003 canary, and the four-task agent-context benchmark remain open. No quantified token savings are claimed.
Owner, device, deployment, and release gates remain separate and unperformed.
